### Quiet Walk - Feb. 17
Author: Quiet Walk
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/quiet-walk/quiet-walk-feb-17-1126598.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 3:21-22
Points:
- Remembering God's past victories provides courage and hope when facing future uncertainties.
- Just as Moses reassured Joshua before entering Canaan, God's past faithfulness anchors current leadership transitions.
- Modern struggles and giants are frequently spiritual or emotional rather than physical armies.
- Believers must not succumb to fear, trusting that God Himself fights their battles.
